name: EV charger installation
summary: How expats install EV chargers in Singapore — condo MCST approvals, load assessments, home vs workplace charging, and installer vs dealer package trade-offs.
body:
EV charging at home depends on parking rights, electrical load, and condo by-laws. Many MCSTs require applications, licensed electricians, and metered billing setups before wallbox install.

## Decision points
- Condo visitor vs designated lot charging rules
- Single-phase load assessment and DB upgrades
- Wallbox brand compatibility with your EV
- Dealer package vs independent licensed installer
- Workplace / mall charging as interim backup

Renters need landlord and MCST consent in writing.

## How to choose
Prefer installers who handle the MCST paperwork pack and provide load calculation sheets. Ask about RFID / app access for shared chargers. Confirm warranty for both hardware and labour.

## Practical tip
Start the MCST application before the car arrives. Hardware lead times are shorter than committee approval cycles.
